messages:
maya: heads-up apiserver latency creeping in eu-west1, lots of 429s and watch reconnects. saw etcd leader raft heartbeats delayed.
jordan: seen it, dashboards show apiserver p95 -> 420ms, error rate 3.7% :eyes:
maya: logs show controller-manager retry loops for rtx-gpu-attach, attach-controller flooding the API, spikes coincide with GPU pool autoscale
samir: is this the attach storm we fixed last month? any kernel ooms or node reboots?
maya: no reboots, kernel looks fine. network egress from hostpool-b is flapping to nat-gw-eu-west1-2 -> packetloss 0.6%
ash: @maya can you paste the top apiserver stack traces
maya: ```
[apiserver] 2026-03-18T11:23:12Z GET /api/v1/watch/pods 503 1.2s
etcdserver: leader transfer in progress, slow apply
controller-runtime: reconcile loop timeout for attach-controller, retries=12
```
jordan: looks like etcd apply latency. what's disk iops on etcd nodes?
maya: iops spiked to 18k on instance-etcd-2, node `i-0a1b2c3d` - avg await 45ms
samir: could be WAL writeback + NAT flaps causing heartbeats to lag. Any recent deploys?
maya: deploy-bot: deployed controller-manager v1.2.5 -> confirmed at 11:15 (but config unchanged)
deploy-bot: deployment controller-manager/v1.2.5 rolled to 3/3 pods
ash: quick mitigations: scale down attach-controller to 1, set `--max-watches=2000` temporarily, throttle attach retries in config
jordan: also bump etcd compaction window? run `etcdctl defrag`? worried about causing more io
maya: plan: 1) scale attach-controller 3->1 2) adjust attach retry backoff 3) cordon high await etcd node and `etcdctl snapshot` 4) open ticket to infra for nat-gw health
samir: +1, also adding egress rule to route GPU attach traffic to nat-gw-eu-west1-1 as fallback
maya: doing scale now: `kubectl scale deployment attach-controller -n kube-system --replicas=1`
maya: scaled, saw immediate drop in reconcile loops :thumbsup:
maya: running `etcdctl snapshot save /tmp/snap.db --endpoints=https://etcd-eu-west1:2379`
ash: monitor p95 and watch count, I'll watch for apiserver 5xxs
jordan: apiserver p95 down to 180ms, errors -> 0.8% :relieved:
maya: infra confirmed nat-gw-eu-west1-2 has degraded uplink, circuit provider switchover in progress
samir: postmortem action: add cross-region nat pairs and better fallback, document attach-controller backoff defaults
maya: note cost implication: fallback adds egress path egress charges, estimate +$2-3k/mo if permanent
ash: going to revert attach-controller replicas to 3 after stable + add feature flag for exponential backoff
maya: thanks all. will file incident and add timestamps to rollout notes.
ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-0318 created by maya, severity=sev2, link https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-0318
maya: closing thread for now, will update inc.
